en.NAME: TITLE

en.NAME: ITEM 1 QUESTION
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

en.NAME: ITEM 1 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: Your contract sets a snowfall threshold (e.g. 2 in / 5 cm). When the local station reports it, dispatch is automatic.

en.NAME: ITEM 2 QUESTION
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: What if the SLA window is missed?

en.NAME: ITEM 2 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: Every response is logged against the window; misses are flagged in your season log and credited per contract terms.

en.NAME: ITEM 3 QUESTION
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

en.NAME: ITEM 3 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: Yes — lots, walkways and loading zones, with per-surface pricing and a compliance report per storm.

en.NAME: ITEM 4 QUESTION
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: Can I get proof of service for insurance?

en.NAME: ITEM 4 ANSWER
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS-authored value for Granite Ridge Snow Removal.

value.en: Each visit carries GPS, timestamps, photos and materials used — exportable as a compliance pack.
